criterion: unordered candidate pairs (a, b) with rank_a < rank_b (a is ground-truth cleaner) where sign(markers_a - markers_b) is 0 (stratum 'tie': equal literal SPAGH_ counts) or opposed to sign(rank_a - rank_b), i.e. +1 (stratum 'antiordered': the cleaner candidate carries MORE markers). On this subset a judge that ranks by counting literal SPAGH_ markers is capped at chance: it scores exactly 0.5 on ties by convention and is always wrong on anti-ordered pairs. (In the dev data the anti-ordered stratum is empty: marker count never decreases with rank, so the subset is exactly the tie stratum.)
